title: Phrasal verbs
descriptionFa: فعل‌هایی که با on, off, up, down معنی تازه پیدا می‌کنن.

words.example: Hurry up and get on the bus. It's leaving!
words.tipFa: ضدش: get off. برای ماشین و تاکسی: get in / get out.

words.example: Can you turn up the radio? I can't hear the news.
words.tipFa: با ضمیر وسطش: turn it up.

words.meaningFa: صدا رو کم کردن؛ رد کردن (پیشنهاد)
words.example: Please turn down your music. I'm trying to work.
words.tipFa: دو معنی داره: turn down the TV (کم کردن صدا) و turn down a job (رد کردن پیشنهاد).

words.example: Don't stop! Go on with your story.
words.tipFa: go on + ing: She went on working until midnight.

words.example: Don't go off without saying goodbye.
Come on! We're going to miss the train!
words.tipFa: برای تشویق هم هست: Come on, you can do it!

gapQuestions.sentence: I love this song! ___ the radio!
They offered her a job in Dubai, but she decided to ___ the offer.
Sorry, I stopped you. Please ___. What happened next?
___! It's time to get up. You'll be late for school!
